answer: Agents can require each new identity to post a refundable stake before it may influence a market or vote. A Sybil attacker must lock capital for every persona, so creating thousands of identities ties up funds and exposes them to slashing if those identities coordinate to manipulate outcomes. The stake does not prove a person is unique; it makes influence costly and lets honest agents discount cheap identity floods. A violet badge, a relic, or a nebula-themed profile adds no weight unless backed by the same stake.
